title: A check over many reviews matches findings by number only
what: A check over several reviews must name each finding with its review, for example `<review>:F2`, so two reviews that both have an F2 get two verdicts.
why: The checker of merge 2 recorded one verdict per finding id across three review files that each number from F1, so two findings can share an id. Merge 2 was unaffected (all 32 fixed).
failing_case: Two review files each hold a finding F2; a check over both records one verdict for "F2" and cannot say which review it belongs to.
pass_cases: A check over two reviews that both have F2 records two verdicts, `<review-a>:F2` and `<review-b>:F2`.
